services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Whether you’re celebrating weddings, anniversaries, or milestone birthdays, our riverboat offers an exclusive and enchanting venue for you and your crew to make lasting memories. Book the boat for as long as you want, and enjoy personalized service, tailor-made menus, and versatile spaces that will ensure an unforgettable event. With the stunning backdrop of the Tennessee River and a variety of entertainment options available, our private charters provide the perfect setting for your unique celebration, where every detail is curated to exceed your expectations. This authentic paddlewheel riverboat is United States Coast Guard approved for 200 passengers. The main deck seats 110 passengers

blurb: Guests cruise the Tennessee River aboard the Star of Knoxville, enjoying views of downtown Knoxville, the waterfront, and the University of Tennessee. The boat offers lunch and dinner cruises, private charters, specialty cruises, and sightseeing cruises. The riverboat features a climate-controlled main deck and an open-air upper deck for scenery and moonlit strolls.
